_comment: Profession list and training tiers. cost is copper; 3 primary professions per character. kind 'secondary' (Kyle, 2026-10-31: cooking "would be 'secondary' since i dont want it to take up profession space") means the profession is free of the max_primary limit: it is not counted against the 3 slots and does not consume one. Everything else about it - tiers, caps, trainers, skill-ups - is identical to a primary, which is the point; the slot rule is the ONLY difference, so there is no second profession system to keep in step.

mining.name: Mining
mining.description: Dig ore from veins. Smelt it into bars at a forge.

herbalism.name: Herbalism
herbalism.description: Gather herbs. The ingredients for Alchemy.

woodcutting.name: Woodcutting
woodcutting.description: Fell trees. Saw logs into planks at a sawmill.

skinning.name: Skinning
skinning.description: Skin slain beasts for leather and hide. The raw stock for Leatherworking.

blacksmithing.name: Blacksmithing
blacksmithing.description: Forge armor, weapons and upgrade kits from bars.

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.description: Brew healing and mana potions and elixirs from herbs.

tailoring.name: Tailoring
tailoring.description: Weave cloth into bolts, cloth armor and bags.

woodworking.name: Woodworking
woodworking.description: Craft shields, staves, bows, crossbows, tomes and arrows from planks.

leatherworking.name: Leatherworking
leatherworking.description: Cure leather into mail and leather armor, armor kits and upgrade kits.

engineering.name: Engineering
engineering.description: Bind elemental essence into metal: trinkets, goggles, explosives and shot.

cooking.name: Cooking
cooking.description: Turn meat into meals that restore health and leave you well fed.
